title: SLiDE: Structured Linear Dynamics for Forecasting with Exogenous Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.19586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate time series forecasting with exogenous inputs is critical across domains, including energy and retail, yet modern deep learning models often overfit to correlations that do not generalize under shifts in these inputs. We propose SLiDE, a Koopman-inspired architecture for forecasting with exogenous inputs that imposes structure on latent temporal dynamics. SLiDE approximates nonlinear system evolution using a learned linear operator in a latent space, combining (i) a history encoder that reconstructs the current latent state from past targets and inputs with (ii) a shared linear rollout driven by future exogenous variables. By enforcing a common linear recurrence across encoding and prediction, SLiDE aligns how past information is encoded with how future states evolve, reducing parameterization and preventing reliance on spurious correlations in the input history. translated_title: SLiDE：用于含外生输入预测的结构化线性动力学
translated_abstract: 在能源和零售等领域，包含外生输入的准确时间序列预测至关重要，然而现代深度学习模型常常过拟合于那些在外生输入发生变化时无法泛化的相关性。我们提出了SLiDE，一种受Koopman理论启发、面向含外生输入预测的架构，它在潜在时间动态上施加了结构约束。SLiDE通过在潜空间中学习一个线性算子来近似非线性系统的演化，结合了从过去目标值和输入重建当前潜状态的历史编码器，以及由未来外生变量驱动的共享线性展开。通过在编码和预测中强制执行共同的线性递推，SLiDE将过去信息的编码方式与未来状态的演化方式对齐，减少了参数化并防止了对输入历史中虚假相关性的依赖。实验表明，SLiDE在真实世界基准上取得了最先进的预测准确率。
tldr: SLiDE是一种受Koopman启发的结构化线性动力学预测架构，通过在潜空间中统一编码与预测的共享线性递推，实现了含外生输入时间序列预测的最先进准确率，同时减少了参数化并避免依赖虚假相关性。
en_tdlr: SLiDE is a Koopman-inspired forecasting architecture that enforces a shared linear recurrence across encoding and prediction in latent space, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy in time series forecasting with exogenous inputs while reducing parameterization and preventing reliance on spurious correlations.
